nodes.description: _rOwned: mapping(address => uint256) reflection-denominated balances used as the primary ledger for non-excluded accounts.
_tOwned: mapping(address => uint256) token-denominated balances used only for accounts flagged in _isExcluded.
_allowances: mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) ERC20 allowance table written by _approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
_isExcluded: mapping(address => bool) marking accounts whose balances are tracked in token units instead of reflections.
_excluded: address[] dynamically grown/shrunk by the owner and fully iterated by _getCurrentSupply.
_rTotal: total reflection supply mutated by every fee-bearing transfer and by reflect().
_tFeeTotal: cumulative fee accounting counter, incremented by _reflectFee and by reflect().
_tTotal: immutable total token supply (100000000000 * 10**6 * 10**9) used as denominator for the rate.
_owner: privileged address of the inherited Ownable contract, graded by the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller returned by Context._msgSender(); drives balances, allowances and the onlyOwner check.
GrumpyHoge constructor: mints the entire reflection supply to _msgSender().
transfer(address,uint256): forwards _msgSender() as sender into _transfer.
approve(address,uint256): calls _approve for _msgSender(), overwriting the existing allowance.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves tokens then decrements the caller allowance by amount.
increaseAllowance(address,uint256): adds addedValue to the caller allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance(address,uint256): subtracts subtractedValue from the caller allowance via _approve.
balanceOf(address): returns _tOwned for excluded accounts, otherwise tokenFromReflection(_rOwned[account]).
allowance(address,address): reads _allowances[owner][spender].
reflect(uint256): reduces _rTotal and the caller's _rOwned by rAmount and inflates _tFeeTotal without a matching transfer.
reflectionFromToken(uint256,bool): view helper converting token amounts to reflection amounts.
tokenFromReflection(uint256): divides rAmount by the current rate derived from _getRate().
excludeAccount(address) onlyOwner: flags an account, caches its _tOwned balance and pushes it into _excluded.
includeAccount(address) onlyOwner: linearly scans and mutates _excluded, clears _tOwned and the exclusion flag.
_transfer(address,address,uint256): validates addresses/amount and dispatches to one of four excluded-state branches.
_transferStandard: debits/credits _rOwned for two non-excluded accounts and applies the reflection fee.
_transferToExcluded: debits _rOwned from the sender and credits both _tOwned and _rOwned of the recipient.
_transferFromExcluded: debits both _tOwned and _rOwned from the sender and credits _rOwned of the recipient.
_transferBothExcluded: applies dual _tOwned/_rOwned accounting on both sides of the transfer.
_reflectFee(uint256,uint256): subtracts rFee from _rTotal and adds tFee to _tFeeTotal.
_getValues(uint256): packs token/reflection amounts and fee using _getTValues, _getRate and _getRValues.
_getTValues(uint256): computes tTransferAmount and a hard-coded zero tFee.
_getRValues(uint256,uint256,uint256): multiplies token amounts by currentRate to obtain reflection amounts.
_getRate(): divides the current reflection supply by the token supply.
_getCurrentSupply(): iterates the whole _excluded array to derive rSupply/tSupply and can revert to the globals.
_approve(address,address,uint256): zero-address checks then writes _allowances[owner][spender] = amount.
transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner: reassigns _owner to newOwner.
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0), permanently disabling privileged functions.
Unsafe operation: allowance is overwritten by an absolute amount, enabling the classic ERC20 approve front-running race.
Unsafe operation: unbounded push into the _excluded array, permanently increasing the gas cost of every rate query.
Unsafe operation: unbounded iteration over _excluded inside includeAccount and _getCurrentSupply, enabling gas-griefing/DoS through owner exclusions.
Unsafe operation: reflect() permanently reduces _rTotal while only crediting _tFeeTotal, distorting the reflection rate for all holders.
Unsafe operation: multi-step mutation of _rOwned/_tOwned/_rTotal/_tFeeTotal inside the transfer branch functions.
